ELEMPAR.description: Change Element Parameters (ELEMPAR). Modifies the local axis / beta angle of selected elements; the operation performed is driven by iMETHOD and, within LOCAL_AXIS, by iMODE and iASSIGN.

Argument.description: Request body (ELEMPAR_REQUEST). Selects elements by number and applies a parameter change.

KEYS.description: Element numbers to modify. Must contain at least one element; elements not matching the target type (line elements needing a section when iELEMTYPE=1, or plate/plane-stress elements when iELEMTYPE=2) are skipped.

iMETHOD.description: Parameters type selector. Currently only 4 is supported (change local axis / beta angle); any other value is rejected.

iELEMTYPE.description: Element type target. 1 = line elements that require a section; 2 = plate / plane-stress elements.

iMODE.description: Mode. 1 = Assign (set an absolute value, further controlled by iASSIGN); 2 = Change (add an angle increment using ANGLEINCRE).

iASSIGN.description: Assign type (used when iMODE=1). 1 = fixed beta angle (BETAANGLE); 2 = beta reference point, orientation TRUE (BETA_WXPOS/WYPOS/WZPOS); 3 = beta reference point, orientation FALSE (BETA_WXPOS/WYPOS/WZPOS); 4 = local axis by coordinate direction (iLOCALAXIS, iCOORDIR, XPOS/YPOS/ZPOS). Range 1~4.

XPOS.description: [iMODE=1,iASSIGN=4] Origin point X used for coordinate-direction axis definition.

YPOS.description: [iMODE=1,iASSIGN=4] Origin point Y used for coordinate-direction axis definition.

ZPOS.description: [iMODE=1,iASSIGN=4] Origin point Z used for coordinate-direction axis definition.

ANGLEINCRE.description: [iMODE=2] Angle increment added to the current beta angle.
